overview: This enum names possible attack-property labels for command-list entries with no traced source path from the labels to icons.

None.technical: Declared as the default-style None member and used throughout the read-only command-list export. No C++ reader for these enum arrays was found in the available Source.

DirectAttack.simple: A label for a direct attack property.
DirectAttack.technical: Declared as DirectAttack in the enum. The command-list row stores arrays of these values. No traced consumer maps DirectAttack to an icon or gameplay effect, and the read-only export contains no DirectAttack entry.

notes: The row struct declares twelve separate arrays of this enum, one for each command-list attack slot.
The read-only export contains only None in those arrays.
UGameCommandListActionWidget collapses every property icon because PropertyIconResources is assigned an empty array in BuildContents, so the available source cannot establish an enum-to-icon mapping.
